pairs.why: A's fan is larger and fills the frame like the real cards, with softer, smoother shading; B is smaller and slightly harsher in contrast.
A has a cleaner, more saturated pink with simpler lace, while B's lace is busier and more texture-heavy than the smooth real cards.
B's pink is a bit more saturated and its folds are more clearly shaped, nearer the bold real fan; otherwise the two are almost the same.
B's pleats are slightly bolder and more saturated, and A's lace edge has more fine see-through detail, which the lessons count against.
B has slightly richer pink and deeper fold shading, like the chunky real fan; A is a little paler and flatter.
A's fan sits larger and reads as smoother and bolder; B is smaller with a washed-out background, though the difference is tiny.
The two are almost the same in finish, color and build, and both have the same fine-textured lace that the real cards lack.
A's fan is bigger and more saturated against a richer blue, closer to the real cards' bold color; B looks a bit faded.
